title: 第8章 被埋了
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

土坑下是一堆垃圾，臭气熏天的，林知渔被臭得受不了，于是手抓着坑边沿，站了起来。

不远处，两个男人正拿着铁锹一下又一下地砸着地上小狗的脑袋。

小狗呜咽着，它挣扎着起身，前腿刚站起来，就又被铁锹砸倒在地。

林知渔看清了，是那只寻狗启事上的狗！

“已经被吃掉了，还怎么拿出来，再说了这得多恶心啊？”

拿着铁锹的是一个比较黑的男人，眉骨上有一条伤疤，他将衣袖挽到了手肘处，露出了满是红色伤痕的手臂。

站在他对面的，是一个身形偏消瘦的男人。

林知渔没着急打草惊蛇，她先是环顾了一圈，将四周的景象都记了下来，只可惜这里只是一处废弃的工厂，没有什么明显的标识，她并不知道具体是在什么地方。

在确定好这些信息之后，林知渔便准备从坑里面爬出去。

谁料她听到了那两个男人的谈话。

“还好只有5克，不然我得心疼死。”

“没事儿，今天晚上我再给你介绍一个好路子，他们着急出货会便宜一些。”

林知渔皱起了眉头。

这听起来就不是什么正经东西啊。

“真的假的？”

“最近查得比较紧，那边又着急拿钱出港。”

“哈哈哈那就谢谢豹哥了。”

林知渔看着那只奄奄一息的狗，估计再被打一铁锹，就必死无疑了。

铁锹高高举起。

“住手！”

听见陌生的声音，￼那两个男人齐齐回头，再看到从坑里跑出来的女人，他们两人互相对视了一眼，满是不可置信。

他们不确定刚才的对话，这个女人听到了多少。

“你是谁？为什么会出现在这里？”

Page (1/3)

There was a pile of garbage under the pit, and the stench was overwhelming. Lin Zhiyu couldn't stand the stench, so he grabbed the edge of the pit and stood up.

Not far away, two men were hitting the head of the puppy on the ground with shovels again and again.

The puppy whimpered and struggled to get up. As soon as it stood up on its front legs, it was knocked to the ground again by the shovel.

Lin Zhiyu saw clearly that it was the dog on the missing dog notice!

"It's already been eaten, how can you take it out? Besides, how disgusting is it?"

The person holding the shovel was a darker man with a scar on his brow. He rolled up his sleeves to his elbows, revealing his arms covered with red scars.

Standing opposite him was a thin man.

Lin Zhiyu was not in a hurry to alert the enemy. She first looked around and took note of the surrounding scenery. Unfortunately, it was just an abandoned factory with no obvious signs. She didn't know where it was specifically.

After confirming this information, Lin Zhiyu was ready to climb out of the pit.

Unexpectedly, she heard the conversation between the two men.

"Fortunately, it's only 5 grams, otherwise I would be heartbroken."

"It's okay. I will introduce you a good way tonight. It will be cheaper if they are in a hurry to ship."

Lin Zhiyu frowned.

This doesn't sound like anything serious.

"Really or not?"

"The inspections have been tighter recently, and they are anxious to get money out of the port."

"Hahaha, thank you Brother Bao."

Lin Zhiyu looked at the dying dog. He estimated that if he was hit with a shovel, he would definitely die.

The shovel was raised high.

"Stop!"

Hearing the unfamiliar voice, the two men turned around and saw the woman running out of the pit. They looked at each other in disbelief.

They weren't sure how much of the conversation the woman had heard.

"Who are you? Why are you here?"
